actionItems.unavailableLabel: Pending approvals could not be checked

dashboard.title: Approval Requests
dashboard.subtitle: Manage approval requests across all modules
dashboard.empty: No requests are waiting for approval
dashboard.emptyHint: Approval requests will appear here when users request approval for documents, equipment checkouts, and other operations.
dashboard.emptyApproved: No requests have been approved yet
dashboard.emptyAll: There are no approval requests yet
dashboard.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, number or type…
dashboard.emptyNoDecideHint: Approving is a separate right your account does not have, so requests from other people are not listed here. Your own appear once you ask for approval.
dashboard.noMatchHint: The search reads what a card shows — a name, a number or a type — on this tab only. Try another word, or another tab.
dashboard.checkoutAnyone: The request names nobody: the approval covers the next checkout, whoever it goes to.

workflows.title: Approval Workflows
workflows.subtitle: Configure multi-stage approval workflows per target type
workflows.selfApproveBanner: Tip: if a user is the only assigned approver on a stage, that stage is approved automatically on their behalf when they request approval. An open stage is not — when the requester is the only one holding the "Approve requests" permission, the request waits until somebody else holds it.
workflows.emptyHint: Create a workflow to define who needs to approve operations of each type.
workflows.emptyHintReadOnly: No workflow has been configured yet. Ask someone who can configure workflows to add one.
workflows.emptyNoReadHint: Your role may not read approval workflows, so this list is always empty for you — even when the organization has them configured. Ask an administrator for the approvals read permission.
workflows.name: Workflow Name
workflows.noTargetTypes: No switched-on module asks for approvals. Switch on the module for warehouse documents, purchase orders or equipment checkouts first.
workflows.duplicateTarget: A workflow already exists for this target type
workflows.created: Workflow saved — switched off until you switch it on
workflows.archived_one: Workflow deleted. Its approval request stays on the Approvals dashboard, under All.
workflows.archived_other: Workflow deleted. Its {{count}} approval requests stay on the Approvals dashboard, under All.
workflows.deactivateConfirm: Nothing will be asked to wait for this approval once it is off. You can switch it back on at any time.
workflows.waitingRelease: Waiting on it now: {{list}}. They are released and go on without approval, and each requester is told why the request was closed.
workflows.demandWarningDocuments: Still requiring approval: {{settings}}. Released documents stop at completion until that setting is cleared or a workflow is active again.
workflows.demandWarningOrders: Still requiring approval: {{settings}}. Released orders go on as confirmed; while the setting is on with no active workflow, new orders cannot be confirmed.
workflows.demandSetting_approval_required_for_type: the document types that need approval
workflows.roleApproverHint: A stage is decided by one of the people named on it — they only need access to approvals.
workflows.gatesDocuments: An active workflow for documents decides who approves. It demands approval for every document only while the document settings name nothing — with a threshold or a type list there, only those documents wait. Deactivate this workflow to stop waiting for approval.
workflows.noApproverInOrganization: Nobody in this organization holds the approvals approve permission, so a stage open to "anyone with the grant" could never be decided. Name an approver, or grant the permission to somebody.
workflows.undecidableHint: A request that reaches this stage will wait there for good. Save it only if you are about to grant the permission or name an approver.

scope.nothingPurchaseOrders: nothing — orders wait only once the purchase-order settings require approval or set a threshold
scope.documentsAboveOrUnpriced: documents worth more than {{amount}}, and documents with no value
scope.purchaseOrdersAbove: orders with a net total above {{amount}}
scope.purchaseOrdersAboveOrUnpriced: orders with a net total above {{amount}}, and orders not fully priced
scope.anythingAboveOrUnpriced: anything worth more than {{amount}}, and anything with no value
scope.foreignCurrency: orders in a currency other than {{currency}}

workflows.scopeOff: Off — holds nothing. Once switched on: {{scope}}
workflows.activateMessage: From now on, these will wait for approval: {{scope}}.
workflows.activateMessageUnknown: From now on, it holds whatever its module sends for approval.
workflows.savedOff: A new workflow is saved switched off — it holds nothing until you switch it on from the list.
workflows.deadEndWaitingHint: The stage cannot be changed while they wait. Their requesters can withdraw them, and then the stage can be edited.
workflows.deadEndFixNamed: Give the named approvers access to approvals, or edit the stage.
workflows.deadEndFixOpen: Give someone the approve permission, or edit the stage.

requesters.label: Who it applies to
requesters.nameSomebody: Choose at least one person or role.
requesters.notChosen: Choose who the workflow applies to.
requesters.hint: Submissions by anyone else go through without approval.
requesters.everyoneHint: Everyone's submissions are covered by this workflow.
requesters.rolesUnavailable: The list of roles is not available to you; choose people instead.

workflows.nameAnApprover: Name at least one person, or let anyone with the approve permission decide.
workflows.roleAddsNobody: Nobody new to add — everyone active with the role “{{role}}” is already named.
workflows.roleMembersFailed: Could not read who holds that role.
workflows.waitingUnavailable: What waits on this workflow could not be checked, so it cannot be switched off right now. Close this and try again.

request.noWorkflow: There is no active approval workflow yet — a request would be refused.
request.approveConfirmNextStage: Stage "{{current}}" gets your approval and the request moves on to "{{next}}". The decision cannot be taken back.
request.approveConfirmFinal: This is the last stage — your approval completes the request. It cannot be taken back.
request.approveConfirmFinalDocument: This is the last stage — your approval completes the request and marks the document ready for warehouse execution. It cannot be taken back.
request.approveConfirmFinalDocumentPosts: This is the last stage — your approval completes the request and posts the document's stock movement now. It cannot be taken back.
request.rejectionReasonRequired: Please provide a reason for rejecting
request.anyApprover: Any approver may approve this stage
request.ownRequestCannotApprove: You submitted this request, so another approver must decide on this stage.
request.awaitingApprover: Waiting for an approver to decide.
request.autoPassed: Passed automatically — the requester is the only approver of this stage
request.approveNotePlaceholder: Add a note for the audit trail (optional)
request.noPermissionToDecide: You don't have permission to decide on approval requests.
request.deadEndCauseNamed: This stage names {{names}}, and they cannot see approvals.
request.deadEndCauseNamedUnknown: This stage names approvers who cannot see approvals.
request.deadEndCauseNoApprover: The stage is open to anyone holding the approve permission, and nobody in this organization holds it.
request.deadEndCauseOnlyRequester: The stage is open to anyone holding the approve permission, but the only holder is the person who asked — and a requester cannot decide their own request.
request.deadEndStepWithdraw: Withdraw the request. The document goes back to Confirmed; asking for approval again lands on the same stage, because the workflow stays as it is.
request.deadEndStepGrantNamed: Give {{names}} access to approvals — a role with the approvals read permission is enough.
request.deadEndStepGrantNamedUnknown: Give the named approvers access to approvals — a role with the approvals read permission is enough.
request.deadEndStepGrantApprove: Give someone the approve permission through a role.
request.deadEndStepAllowSelf: Or, when the requester is an administrator, allow administrators to approve their own requests.
request.deadEndStepLocked: The workflow cannot be changed or switched off while this request waits on it.
request.deadEndStepAskAdminNamed: Ask an administrator to give {{names}} access to approvals.
request.deadEndStepAskAdminNamedUnknown: Ask an administrator to give the named approvers access to approvals.
request.deadEndStepAskAdminApprove: Ask an administrator to give someone the approve permission.
request.deadEndStepAskRequesterUnnamed: Ask the person who raised the request to withdraw it.

deleteWorkflowConfirm: Delete this workflow? It leaves this list. Requests already raised under it are kept on the Approvals dashboard, with the stages they went through.

permissions.readDesc: Can see every approval request in the organization, not just their own
permissions.writeDesc: Can send a document or order for approval
permissions.approveDesc: Can approve or reject pending approval requests
permissions.configureDesc: Can create and edit approval workflows

settings.allowAdminSelfApprove: Admins may approve their own requests
settings.allowAdminSelfApproveDescription: Off by default: an approval step exists to put a second person on the decision. Turn it on when the admin is the only approver and the workflow would otherwise deadlock.

documentQueue.parkedSubtitle: These requests wait at a stage nobody can act on. They never reach the approval queue until the stage is repaired.

documentSetup.consequenceGuarded: Documents of the listed types or above the threshold wait for approval; all others confirm directly.
documentSetup.consequenceNoWorkflow: Documents of the listed types or above the threshold are refused at confirmation until an approval workflow exists; all others confirm directly.
documentSetup.consequenceNeedsWorkflow: Documents of the listed types or above the threshold need approval, which a document workflow has to carry out; all others confirm directly.
documentSetup.consequenceWorkflowOnly: Nothing is set here, so the active document workflow makes every confirmed document wait for approval.
documentSetup.consequenceNothing: Nothing is set here and no document workflow exists, so confirmed documents execute directly.

workflowMissing.title: Approval is required, but nothing enforces it
workflowMissing.description: No approval workflow exists for documents, so confirming one is refused. Create the workflow, or turn the requirement off.
